name: Shimai Ecchi ~Ore ga Kyoushi de Ani de Tanin de~
original_name: 姉妹えっち～俺が教師で兄で他人で～
source:
Hideki is a PE teacher at a high school. One day, he goes to the principal room to meet transfer students. But they are his relatives, Madoka and Yuka...
